name: Dozer
description: In the retrieved Dozer checkout, Sparkle is configured with an HTTPS appcast URL and a SUPublicEDKey, and the preferences controller exposes SUUpdater's automatic-check setting. The checked-in appcast has one 4.0.0 item dated 20 August 2019 and includes a sparkle:edSignature, so the feed snapshot is stale relative to the checkout's 4.2.0 bundle metadata.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not historical release re-verification; the checked-in feed may be stale or archival, and published bundle/signature validity plus Sparkle's framework enforcement were not independently verified.
